# Platinum Hotels

> > Budget-friendly hotel chain across Ahmedabad and Udaipur offering comfortable accommodations, event venues, and destination wedding packages.

Platinum Hotels operates multiple properties including Platinum Inn (Vasna), Platinum Residency (Prahlad Nagar) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and Platinum Royal Excellency in Udaipur, Rajasthan. The chain specializes in affordable business and leisure travel, pure vegetarian dining, corporate events, and budget destination weddings under 10 lakhs.
